HexKagune 1.0.37 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 48). Testing build.

- **Piercing Salvation cone:** while the blades form the lance, each one's side and back points fold flat along its long point, so the six read as one smooth spear instead of a spiky cluster; they unfold as the lance comes back.
